questionText: What is the maximum of the timeframe-confluence scale, and is 20 a passing threshold or just the score of this example?
reason: The caption is garbled ('we were greatest a 20 towards yourself because it's 10 per time frame'). Ten points per timeframe is legible; the denominator is not. Four timeframes are named elsewhere (weekly, daily, 4H, lower), which would imply 40, but sub-4H is excluded from directional scoring in this same passage, which would imply 30. MOGO must not pick one - that would be inventing a missing definition.
